caption: The drawing depicts a stylized botanical form placed diagonally across a plain off-white or beige background. The composition features a thin black stem or vine that runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. Attached to this stem are several greenish-blue leaves with jagged edges. Near the top of the stem, there are two circular flowers with serrated edges and a small round center, both positioned side by side. Above the flowers is a single, narrow, pointed leaf and a trumpet-shaped flower pointing to the right. Additionally, curly tendrils extend from both the upper and lower portions of the stem, forming loose spirals. The linework is concise and the color palette is limited to shades of greenish-blue for the plant elements and black for the outlines and diagonal stem.
title: Iron Work
